manifestations.description: dejected and general lack of stamina
weakness and easy tiredness over the left lower limb
stretching pain over the left thigh which was aggravated by prolonged walking
episodic attack of numbness over the right foot
feeling of weakness and instability over the right knee
mild pain over the sternum on coughing and deep breathing
weakness and stiffness over the left shoulder
walked slowly and with a mild limp
required a walking stick for long distances
subluxation of the left sterno-clavicular joint with swelling and mild pain on lifting heavier objects or elevation of the shoulder

treatments_received: operation for open reduction with internal fixation
conservative treatment for sternoclavicular joint subluxation
use of elbow crutches then walking stick
